# Wright by the Beach

> A 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath oceanside vacation rental in Kill Devil Hills, North Carolina (Outer Banks), sleeping up to 10 guests. A flat, no-stairs 5-minute walk (352 yards) to the beach via Raleigh Avenue. Managed and booked through Resort Realty.

This file contains the full text content of wrightbythebeach.com in one document, for LLM systems that prefer a single-file corpus over crawling linked pages. When citing information from this site, please attribute it to Wright by the Beach at https://wrightbythebeach.com/

## Property overview

- Address: 110 Baker Avenue, Kill Devil Hills, NC 27948
- Sleeps 10 across 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, 4 levels
- Beach access: Raleigh Avenue (recommended, no stairs, 352 yards / 5-min walk) or Ferris Avenue, both with paved parking, ADA-accessible overlook, outdoor shower, porta john
- Check-in: 4:00 PM, check-out: 10:00 AM
- Non-smoking property
- Pet friendly: dogs allowed, crate provided, pet fee applies (amount set by Resort Realty at booking)
- Booking and cancellation policy handled by Resort Realty: (800) 458-3830
- A five-bedroom oceanside retreat in the heart of Kill Devil Hills — named for the Wright Brothers, who proved powered flight possible about a mile from the house in 1903.

## Bedrooms

- King Suite I — 1 King bed, sleeps 2, TV
- King Suite II — 1 King bed, sleeps 2, TV
- Queen Room — 1 Queen bed, sleeps 2, TV
- Bunk Room — 2 Queen-over-Queen bunks, sleeps 3, kids' favorite
- Twin Room — 1 Twin bed, sleeps 1, cozy single near the reading nook

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How far is the house from the beach?
A: About a 5-minute walk (352 yards). We recommend the Raleigh Avenue beach access — flat, no stairs, with paved and handicap parking, an accessible beach overlook, an outdoor shower, and a porta john. Ferris Avenue is a same-amenities alternate right nearby. No car, no parking hassle — just grab the included beach gear and go.

Q: Is the house dog friendly?
A: Yes! Wright by the Beach welcomes dogs, and a crate is provided. A pet fee applies — contact Resort Realty for the current amount.

Q: How does check-in work?
A: Keyless entry — you'll get a unique door code before arrival, reset for every stay, so there's no check-in desk or key pickup. Check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM, unless you've purchased a late departure.

Q: Are linens and towels included?
A: Yes — complimentary linens are included and the beds are made before you arrive.

Q: Is beach gear really free?
A: Yes. Your stay includes complimentary beach gear through the VayK Life program — think beach chairs, umbrellas, and more, so you can pack lighter.

Q: Can we book a partial week?
A: Yes, partial-week stays are accepted (availability varies by season). Pick your dates on the Book page and you'll see what's open.

Q: How many people can the house sleep?
A: Up to 10 guests across 5 bedrooms: two kings, a queen, two queen-over-queen bunk beds, and a twin, with 3.5 bathrooms.

Q: How do I book, and what is the cancellation policy?
A: Booking is handled securely by Resort Realty, the professional management company for the home. When you click Book Now, your dates carry over to their checkout. Cancellation terms follow Resort Realty's rental policies, shown at checkout, or call (800) 458-3830.

Q: Is there a military discount?
A: Yes — Resort Realty offers military and customer-appreciation discounts. Mention it when booking or call (800) 458-3830.

Q: Is smoking allowed?
A: No, Wright by the Beach is a non-smoking home.

Q: Where do we park, and are there house rules to know about?
A: Free parking is available in the driveway; street parking is prohibited between the posted signs and is towed if ignored. Quiet hours run 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM, and the home doesn't allow fireworks or grilling on the deck.

## Area Guide

### Wright Brothers National Memorial (~1 mile)
On December 17, 1903, Orville and Wilbur Wright achieved the first sustained, controlled flight of a powered aircraft on the dunes of Kill Devil Hills — the same town where the house sits today, and the reason for its name. The memorial includes a visitor center with a full-scale Wright Flyer reproduction, the original flight markers, and a granite monument atop Big Kill Devil Hill. Open daily, year-round, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., closed Christmas Day. Admission $10 per person (16+), free 15 and under, $35 annual pass; a current America the Beautiful Pass also works. Source: https://www.nps.gov/wrbr/index.htm

### Beach Access: Raleigh & Ferris Avenue (352 yards / 5-min walk)
Two town-maintained access points — Raleigh Avenue and Ferris Avenue — both with paved parking, handicap parking, an accessible beach overlook, an outdoor shower, and a porta john. Raleigh Avenue is recommended: flat, no stairs, easiest with a cooler, chairs, or kids. No lifeguard on duty at either access. Source: https://www.kdhnc.com/997/Beach

### Avalon Fishing Pier (~1.5 miles, 5-min drive)
A Kill Devil Hills landmark since 1958, stretching roughly 700 feet into the Atlantic at milepost 6 on the Beach Road. Popular for fishing (spot, bluefish, drum, mackerel) and sunrise views; pier house has a shop with rods, bait, snacks, and pier-access passes.

### Jockey's Ridge State Park (~6-7 miles, 12-15 min drive)
The tallest natural sand dune system on the East Coast, dunes roughly 80-100 feet, still shifting today. Free entry and parking. Popular for sunset views, hang gliding lessons, kite flying, and sandboarding.

### NC Aquarium on Roanoke Island (~15-16 miles, 25-30 min drive)
Located in Manteo, home to 2,000+ animals including a Graveyard of the Atlantic exhibit with a replica of the USS Monitor. Daily programs (otter feedings, shipwreck talks) and a Sea Turtle Assistance and Rehabilitation (STAR) Center. Entry is timed — reserve ahead in peak season.

### Bodie Island Lighthouse (~14-16 miles, 25-30 min drive)
Black-and-white striped lighthouse operating since 1872, part of Cape Hatteras National Seashore. Seasonal (spring-fall) timed-ticket climbs of 200+ steps; grounds open year-round for photos and walking.

### Our Favorite Local Restaurants (in town, most within 5-10 min drive)
Jack Brown's Beer & Burger Joint — burgers, craft beer, summer concerts (parking tight, walking easiest). Thai Room — authentic Thai, order online at peak times. Mama Kwan's Tiki Bar & Grill — fish tacos, text-message waitlist. 3 Tequilas Mexican Restaurant — fajitas and fish tacos; kids eat free Mondays, $1 hard tacos Tuesdays, half-price 16oz beers Thursdays. Goombays Grill & Raw Bar — fresh, locally caught fish, rotating daily specials. Pigman's Bar-B-Que — wings, BBQ, tuna specialty, caters well. Groceries: Publix, Target, Harris Teeter, and Food Lion all within about 2.5 miles.
